lines: Ryoku's voice lines and sound effects.

- "How indeed? How can we both be here? Do you not recognize your own son: Sirius? He is wounded in body and soul. We are locked in eternal conflict - by a force we can feel but not see. Slaughtering each other, over and over. We finally found you - alive. We retreat now, and hide. Find us."
- "Sirius, retreat. Recover. There can be no victory today. Our future must survive. Your father will follow the righteous path eventually. Even if he chose the other. Even if he chose Orion."
- "I know you're here. I've already sent the boy. My role in this eternal dance has come to an end. I do not belong here, I welcome death at your hand. Make this a fitting finale."
- "If you side with justice over chaos, there is a place for you aboard Santovan's Oath."
- "I am no leader. But I call you to stand beside me in battle."
- "Hunhow will become upset without a spectacle. Let us arrange one."
- "The presence of the Kuva Witch is an insult to the peace Hunhow created."
- "Come. The grand Sentient calls for a bout."
- "A paradox. This place can only be kept peaceful by the ritual of continuous conflict."
- "She provokes us. Goads us to fight. Honor demands a response."
- "There can be no final victory. But the balance must still be kept."
- "It is a bitter truth, but unless we rise and fight the Wytch, what is left of Hunhow's mind may unravel. Through our battles he finds himself again."
- "Constant battle keeps the blade and mind keen. She presents herself as a target. Let us accept."
- "The peace between Sirius and Orion demands we channel their martial instincts outward. To contain, we must release."
- "Santovan's Oath; equipped with cloaking systems, deadly ranged weapons and unlimited forward ammunition. Everything we need to strike without warning."
- "Cloaking, high-powered ranged weapons, regenerative ammo, and quick bursts of speed. Santovan's Oath is an assassin's ship through and through."

path: During The Kuva Wytch, Uranus Proxima
lines: - Ryoku: "Our mission? Humiliation. Find Vena and cut her down to size."
- "I have challenged the butcher Vena to an assassin's duel. Take her to the brink of oblivion. She must know I am her better."
- "This wretched peace. My blade dulls while Vena's ego swells. No more. We will hone our daggers upon her throat. She must be humbled… To preserve the peace."
- "From his perch within Pontis Tower Hunhow watches, eager for a martial contest. Come, let us find Vena, and give the old Sentient what he desires."

path: During The Kuva Wytch, Uranus Proxima
lines: - "The butcher lurks in this field of stone and ice, from which her Bloodfrenzy Corpus hew sustenance. Look for the biggest asteroid and crack it open."
- "This asteroid field is the beating heart of Vena's operation. Now it's Vena's turn to bleed. Smash the biggest asteroid and take its ore for our ship."
- "Move into position. Collect the asteroid's spoils."
- "Vena's infested filth has pierced our hull. Cleanse this vessel."

lines: - "Turrets ahead. We must hit them first."
- "Turrets. Is this your idea of a trap, Vena. Take them out."

- "A fortress of ice? Forward artillery. Target the walls. This siege will not last long."

lines: - "We're in. Spies tell me that Vena has been toying with a very dangerous weapon. Breach that door."
- "A weapon of rare power is hidden within the ice here. It will be ours. Open those doors."

path: During The Kuva Wytch, Uranus Proxima

- "It was a trap. Do not worry about me. Get in here and kill Vena."

path: During The Kuva Wytch, Uranus Proxima
lines: - "Vena will heal. She always does. Return to Pontis Tower and ready yourself for next time."
- "Vena's scars will fade, but her humiliation will endure."
- "Great and terrible Hunhow, the Wytch Vena has been subdued."

path: During The Kuva Wytch, Uranus Proxima
lines: - "So this is what she was hiding. A glorious void serpent."
- "Behold, the Orowyrm. Let's go for a ride."
- "You have done this before. Haven't you, Tenno? Take us to The Kuva Wytch."
- "There. Her capital ship. Steer. Find your target."
- "Vena, my will is unbreakable. My honor cannot be stained."
- "Welcome, Wytch. How should we do it this time?"
- "Oh great, Hunhow, I dedicate my coming victory to you."
- "Now, what would be the fun in that? Wytch."
- "You will not get that satisfaction today. Not even with these wayward Tenno at your side."
- "Vena. A simple provocation brings you right to my killing floor. A lesson for these Tenno; The vain are easily manipulated."
- "You fight only for the thrill. It blinds you. Makes you weak."
- "Perhaps now Sirius and I can teach you and Orion some much needed manners."
- "Vena, you lack both honor and discipline. You sully The Stalker's legacy."
- "I will not bleed for you, not today."
- "Tenno, you fight well. Vena is unworthy of such noble fury."
- "I have lived to see Sirius reunited with brother and father. Unencumbered by the burden of duty, I fight with abandon. You have been warned, Wytch."
- "Last words? I have not even started."
- "You are going to lose today. You were only ever going to lose. The truce is your salvation. Submit to it."
- "You think you've won, but my Kunai will find your jugular before the day is done."
- "From chaos, must come order. I am Ryoku."
- "Meditation has its value. So does action."
- "Does this pause serve a purpose? Or are you merely indecisive?"
- "I hope you are preparing for our next battle, and not merely counting seconds."
- "If you have no need of me...?"
- "You test my patience for a reason, I presume."
- "Stars may guide us, but the Void fuels us."
- "May the shadows walk with us this day."
- "You would ask a tree to walk."
- "There is a hole in the ship."
- "One generally wishes to keep the hull of one's ship intact, yes?"
- "Did you mean to let them blow a hole in the ship?"
- "Is that a strategic hole in the hull?"
- "I would recommend fixing that hull breach."
- "I do not think a fire in here is tenable."
- "Do you plan to let it burn? Or...?"
- "I have rectified the fire situation for you. You are welcome."
- "I did not enjoy the thought of burning to death in a metal box."
- "One crisis dealt with. I am sure you will find us another."
- "Like the vessels of old - the most improbable is the most deadly."
- "Try not to do that again. Please."
- "It would have been a quick death. But death, all the same."
- "Another has come to join the fray."
- "Death waits for them on my ready blades."
- "Death is the final path you shall walk."
- "The shadows spoke your name. I answered."
- "No tears for you shall be shed."
- "No one is lucky in war. Only those who live and those who do not."
- "Who shall seek vengeance in your name?"
- "Falter not, now is the time to strike!"
- "He who has been brought low must climb again in humility."
- "The only failure is the one from which you do not recover."
- "For this, I give you my thanks."
- "We have suffered losses. Adjust your strategy."
- "We are now fewer in number. Be cautious."
- "One of your crew has died. ...I hope you will not miss them."
- "If you mean to act, do so now!"
- "One must learn the art of death, and life, to survive."
- "The shadows have been warded off, for a time."
- "The shadows come to claim their own."
- "All roads... must be walked... in their time."
- "I am called many things. Ryoku is the kindest."
- "My name is unimportant. My instruction is not."
- "I have trained warriors and buried students. Which are you?"
- "Speak less. Observe more. We begin now."
- "The shadows whisper the name of my blades. You will learn them if you falter."
- "I am what stands between you and failure."
- "I will be your guide through the shadows."
- "Discipline brought you to me. A wise choice."
- "My methods are not gentle. Neither is the world."
- "The first lesson: Silence is not absence."
- "You seek me out? Few do this willingly."
- "You wish to walk unseen? First, learn to see."
- "Death is not to be relished. It is to be respected."
- "Break what does not serve you. Hone what remains."
- "You summon me with eagerness. I do not know why."
- "I am not here to inspire you."
- "Some would know me as Yaiba. But they do not whisper that name in these times."
- "Your reputation precedes you. It means nothing to me."
- "Which one of us is the blade? Which one of us, the sheath?"
- "The cage opens and a bird emerges."
- "Few can walk in two places. Fewer still return unchanged."
- "You stand outside your shell. Impressive. Also dangerous."
- "The spirit unbound is powerful but the body unguarded is weak."
- "To leave the body is to trust the world not to destroy it in your absence."
- "Two forms, two throats. Easier to be killed. Harder to protect."
- "Separation is not transcendence. It is merely risky."
- "You show me your essence. Bold. Foolish. Honest."
- "The body without soul is empty. The soul without body is exposed."
- "The shell stands at rest while the true self walks."
- "To step outside one's skin is to admit the skin was never you."
- "The body is the anchor. You walk free. For now."
- "Between where you were and where you are, I see only vulnerability."
- "The living ghost—a contradiction that walks before me."
- "You prove the body is a choice, not a prison."
- "To master this is to dance on the edge between worlds."
- "The empty vessel and the wandering essence—both are targets."
- "Two minds, one form. We are complete again."
- "You return to flesh. I feel your presence settle like snow."
- "The body accepts what the spirit brings back."
- "We are whole. Stronger for the reunion."
- "I am no longer alone in this skin."
- "Your essence merges with mine. How... odd."
- "This body holds us both now. Crowded, but purposeful."
- "Two become one. The mathematics of the soul defies logic."
- "I feel your presence flood through me like water. I accept its peace."
- "Your return is seamless. As if you never left."
- "I am the house. You, the returning guest. Shall I make tea?"
- "I had grown accustomed to the silence."
- "My body. Your commentary. This will take... adjustment."
- "Move like smoke. Strike like lightning. Vanish like morning mist."
- "Death should arrive like a whisper, not a shout."
- "A calm mind cuts deeper than a sharp edge."
- "The patient hand guides the swiftest blades."
- "Fear is the heaviest weapon you can carry into battle."
- "Technique without thought is chaos. Thought without technique is death."
- "The loudest warrior dies first. Remember this."
- "Your death is already written. I am merely the ink."
- "Watch closely. You will not get a second chance."
- "I am the last lesson you will ever receive."
- "I have killed better foes in worse conditions."
- "I am the answer to the question you should not have asked."
- "Come, greet your death if you so wish!"
- "I am the scythe. You are the wheat."
- "The student who does not listen... feels."
- "The way was shown. You refused it."
- "Your death was written in your stance."
- "I am the consequence of your choices."
- "You fought with passion. I fought with purpose."
- "This was inevitable from the moment your name was written."
- "I was the answer to someone's problem."
- "You join the many who come before."
- "Your death was purchased. I merely delivered."
- "I have ended better souls with less effort."
- "The world moves on without you. It will not notice."
- "Your road led to me. It has now ended."
- "You had but one moment to escape. You wasted it."
- "The blade does not judge. It simply concludes."
- "You exit quietly. As you should have lived."
- "I have forgotten you already. The world will follow."
- "I moved like smoke. They moved like the wind."
- "The teacher who stops learning becomes the lesson."
- "The wheel turns. I fall beneath it."
- "Certainty will rust the purest of blades."
- "He who teaches humility but does not practice it will learn it painfully."
- "Every master... will someday find his better."
- "The lesson is mine. But it comes too late."
- "Even silent blades make a sound when they fall."
- "I owe you a debt. I will not forget it."
- "I walked with death. Now I return."
- "My stance was broken...now it is restored."
- "I fell. You raised me. Together, then?"
- "I have seen the other side. It... can wait."
- "My body was broken. My will was not."
- "I fell in shadow. I rise in purpose."
- "My blades once more find my hands."
- "I owe you a debt beyond words."
- "Their victory was temporary. My resolve is not."
- "The grave held no lessons I needed."
- "I owe you my life. Allow me to spend it wisely."
- "Defeat is a whetstone that can sharpen the dullest of blades."
- "The river that meets the stone does not break. It finds another way."
- "This announces our arrival. It is unwise."
- "Speed is worthless if everyone hears you coming."
- "I do not trust that which I cannot silence."
- "Fine. When they are alerted to our presence, remember I objected."
- "Patience and footsteps have never failed me."
- "The most garish of arrivals ensures the briefest of stays."
